name: opsphere
description: DevOps and SRE intelligence for ChatGPT — remote MCP gateway for Datadog, Vercel, GitHub, AWS, incident triage, CI/CD pipelines, deployment status, and post-mortems.

interface.shortDescription: DevOps & SRE MCP — Datadog, Vercel, GitHub, AWS, incidents & CI
interface.longDescription: Opsphere connects ChatGPT to your operational stack through a secure remote MCP gateway (mcp-cursor.opsphere.io). First-time setup walks you through account status, work context, and your first integration. Then use guided skills to investigate outages and site-down incidents, run DNS/HTTP/TLS endpoint health checks, diagnose failed GitHub Actions and Bitbucket pipelines, search Datadog logs and errors, check Vercel and multi-platform deployment status, triage Sentry and Jira, and write structured post-mortems. Configure Datadog, AWS, GitHub, Cloudflare, Jira, Sentry, Bitbucket, and more from chat — credentials stay encrypted on the gateway, never in the plugin bundle. Community plan with trial; same tools as the Opsphere Cursor plugin.
defaultPrompt: @plan-and-usage check my account and summarize my plan in plain language
@set-work-context help me describe my stack, environments, and tools
@configure-integration guide me through connecting Datadog, AWS, or GitHub
